channel.title: Number Bond Rounds for Kids
channel.description:
Quick number bond rounds for young learners: make five, make ten, make twenty and more. A friendly voice asks, pauses for your child to answer out loud, then gives the answer. About a minute and a half each.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of Number Beasts: Bond Lab, a kids' maths game where you launch a number and make ten. Number Beasts: Bond Lab on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
